listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Your body is like a complex machine with many parts working together!
THE 6 MAIN BODY SYSTEMS:
1. SKELETAL SYSTEM - Your bones
- 206 bones in an adult body
- Protects organs, supports body, allows movement
2. MUSCULAR SYSTEM - Your muscles
- Over 600 muscles
- Allows movement, keeps body warm
3. CIRCULATORY SYSTEM - Heart and blood
- Heart pumps blood through blood vessels
- Blood carries oxygen and nutrients
4. RESPIRATORY SYSTEM - Lungs and breathing
- Brings oxygen into the body
- Removes carbon dioxide
5. DIGESTIVE SYSTEM - Stomach and intestines
- Breaks down food into nutrients
- Gives your body energy
6. NERVOUS SYSTEM - Brain and nerves
- Controls all body functions
- Allows you to think, feel, and react
All these systems work TOGETHER to keep you alive and healthy!
Science Vocabulary:
dictation: Your body is like a complex machine with many parts working together!
